segments.name: Design Therapeutics, Inc.
segments.description: Develops therapeutic candidates for inherited diseases driven by nucleotide repeat expansion, using its proprietary GeneTAC platform.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one operating and reportable segment, Design Therapeutics, Inc., which is focused on utilizing the Company's proprietary GeneTAC ® platform to design and develop therapeutic candidates for inherited diseases driven by nucleotide repeat expansion.
